sloka: तत्र आसीत् पिन्गलो गार्ग्यः त्रिजटः नाम वै द्विजः ।क्षतवृत्तिर्वने नित्यम् फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली ॥२-३२-२९॥
transliteration: tatra āsīt pingalo gārgyaḥ trijaṭaḥ nāma vai dvijaḥ ।kṣatavṛttirvane nityam phālakuddālalāṅgalī ॥2-32-29॥

translations.english: A brahmin by name, Trijata, a descendant of sage Garga and of reddishbrown colour used to live in that region earning his livelihood in the forest by digging the earth with an ironspade and a plough.
